d:
The Pistons defeated the Hornets, 124-91 tonight in Charlotte. Cade Cunningham contributed a team-high 33 points to go with 7 assists 5 rebounds and 5 steals, with Duncan Robinson of the Pistons adding an additional 24 points (8-11 FG, 6-9 3P) in the game. Brandon Miller finished with a team-high 17 points along with 4 assists for the Hornets in the losing effort. The Pistons improve their record to 6-1 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 3-5 for the season.
